notes.title: GO RUSH!! World Release & Massive Major Update Campaign
notes.content:
Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links now gives players the ability to experience the world of GO RUSH!!, along with many new characters and cards!

And that's not all: we've also added Fusion Summoning to Rush Duels, plus a feature to add special processing to your cards—making them Chronicle Cards, which reflect your personal Dueling memories.

The game menus have also been revamped to provide greater immersion into the Yu-Gi-Oh! universe.

To celebrate the update, we're currently holding a special campaign which gives players "Ancient Gear Golem" (Rush Duels ver.) plus a Structure Deck and Packs from the latest BOX.

[url=steam://run/601510 style=button]Launch The Game Now[/url]

notes.title: Campaign to Commemorate 2,500 Days since Launch
notes.content:
Celebrating 2,500 Days since the launch of Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links!
A special campaign is underway to commemorate this milestone!

- Login Bonus
Receive a Commemorative UR Dream Ticket (Speed/Prismatic) and obtain the ace monster of your choice! You will also receive a UR Dream Pack (Rush/Prismatic)!

- Bonus Stamps
Log in every day to get awesome items! You can get 3 Character Unlock Tickets, 3 Skill Tickets, and an SR Dream Ticket (Speed)!

- Special Mission Bingo
By completing the bingo sheets, get fantastic items such as a UR Dream Ticket (Speed), a total of 500 Gems, 50 BOX Chips, and 100 Skill Chips!

- Commemorative Accessories Popularity Poll
The archetypes with the highest total number of votes will be used to create an Icon, Card Sleeves, and a Game Mat, which will be gifted to everyone!

Enjoy Dueling with your favorite ace monster!


 Check out the in-game notification for more details!
[url=steam://run/601510 style=button]Launch The Game Now[/url]

notes.title: 100th Legendary Duelists!
notes.content:
A special campaign is underway to celebrate the 100th Legendary Duelist in "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links"! Enjoy Duel Links along with various Duelists!

Various campaigns are underway!
- Login Bonus
Get spectacular cards like the UR "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" (Prismatic), UR "Blue-Eyes Alternative White Dragon,"
celebration Game Mat, and a Skill related to "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"!

- Bonus Stamps
Login everyday to get awesome items! You can get 3 Character Unlock Tickets, 3 Skill Tickets, an UR Dream Ticket, and "Blue-Eyes Alternative White Dragon"!

- Special Mission Bingo
Get UR Dream Pack with 1 bingo, and get a total of 500 Gems and the UR "Blue-Eyes Alternative White Dragon," 100 BOX Chips, 100 Skill Chips, and UR/SR Tickets by completing the sheet!

 Check out the in-game notification for more details!

notes.title: Notice: Upcoming Content
notes.content:
Here are new additions to the game, planned for the near future.

[h1][Early July][/h1]

[list]

 [*][b]Special Duels are Back![/b]

Duel using Decks with certain Skill and card requirements depending on your Legendary Duelist!

Try out these special rules!

*Special Duels will be held separately from Ranked Duels.

 [*][b]Obtain a Legendary Duelist[/b]

A special Duel-A-Thon is coming!
This is your chance to unlock Syrus Truesdale again!

Duel to obtain new cards!

[i]"I'm ready to take on the world!"[/i]

[/list]

[h1][Mid July][/h1]

[list]

 [*][b]Return to Duel Island![/b]

A familiar face returns BEARing gifts!

Test your skills at the new and improved Duel Island!

 [*][b]A certain Duelist is making a return![/b]

Superb Téa is coming back!

Duel her to obtain new cards!

[/list]

[h1][Late July][/h1]

[list]

 [*][b]Obtain a Legendary Duelist[/b]

A fan favorite GX character will finally be unlockable!

Obtain new cards to build a powerful Deck!

Event exclusive items with various effects are here! Use them to earn extra Rewards and EXP!

 [*][b]WCS 2018 Finals Event Page[/b]

The event page for the WCS 2018 is open!

Don't miss your chance to watch Dueling at the highest level!

[/list]

[h1][Early August][/h1]

[list]

[*][b]A Certain Legendary Duelist will appear in Duel World! [/b]

Serious Chazz will appear in Duel World!

Duel to obtain new cards!

[/list]

[h1][Other Updates Planned for July][/h1]

[list]

 [*]The ability to increase Duel Rewards and EXP by Dueling multiple standard Duelists at once will be added.

 [*]The ability to train your very own Kuriboh by Dueling will be added. You can earn monthly Rewards based on its progress.

[/list]

In addition to the events mentioned above, there will be campaigns, new cards added, and updates to various features.

To create an even better experience for our players, we will continue to add new content and work out balancing issues.

Thank you for playing "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links."

*You must be at Stage 4 or higher to participate in this event.

notes.title: Global Launch First Anniversary Campaigns!
notes.content:
The following campaigns are underway in celebration of the first anniversary of the global launch!


[h1]Obtain an Egyptian God Card[/h1]

Complete a special Mission to receive "Slifer the Sky Dragon"!

Check out the in-game notifications for further details!

*This is a Lifetime Mission.
*Once Strings is defeated, he will no longer appear in Duel World.
*The regular Duel Results screen will not appear after defeating Strings.

[h1]Log-in Ticket Bonus[/h1]

You can obtain up to 3 UR Tickets and 3 SR Tickets by logging in every day! Not only that, but 1 UR Ticket and 1 SR Ticket will be Prismatic!

*Tickets can be exchanged for cards by from the banner in Duel World.

[h1]Accessory and Gem Giveaway[/h1]

Obtain exclusive Card Sleeves/Game Mat, as well as 1,500 Gems by logging in!

*Please claim them from your Gift Box.


Thank you for playing "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links."

notes.title: Update: Regarding Shop Maintenance
notes.content:
The following issue had been occurring:

・Content sold at the Shop was priced incorrectly for players paying in Euros, Norwegian krone, and Colombian peso.

This issue has been fixed, and the Shop in the Steam version has been set to the correct prices.
Along with this, the Shop maintenance has ended, and players are now able to use the Shop.

According to our investigation, no purchases were made at the incorrect prices.

We sincerely apologize for the trouble and confusion, and appreciate your patience.

Thank you for playing "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links."
